name: Yuzubara · Gremlet #6
description:
A hot-spring capybara balancing a yuzu on its head. Nothing ruffles it.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Yuzubara in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
